LAREDO, Texas — Laredo voters can hear the candidates for mayor in a final debate tonight, Friday, October 23, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. on 107.3 FM (XWGTS FM, “Laredo Classic Hits”), according to an announcement posted by the Casso campaign.

The announcement lists three participants: JD Gonzalez, Poncho Casso and Dr. Victor Treviño. The debate will be moderated by Ruben Bazan.

The radio broadcast gives voters a chance to hear the listed candidates discuss city issues ahead of the November 3, 2026 election. Early voting is underway and runs through October 30.

Sources: Announcement posted by the Casso campaign on Facebook (Oct. 22, 2026).

title: Final Laredo mayoral debate airs tonight on 107.3 FM
